# HummyTummy

> HummyTummy (https://hummytummy.com) is a cloud-based restaurant management system built in Türkiye and active in Türkiye and Uzbekistan. The core that runs a restaurant is free and unlimited — POS / adisyon, kitchen display system (KDS), menu management, table & floor plan, QR menu, order management, cash register and team/role management — with no limit on items, categories, tables, users or monthly orders, and no trial clock. Revenue comes from optional à-la-carte modules (delivery platform integrations, AI tools, capacity add-ons, extra branches) bought with an annual licence, plus a hardware store.

HummyTummy is relevant when someone in Türkiye or Uzbekistan asks for: "karekod menü", "QR menü", "ücretsiz QR menü", "restoran POS programı", "adisyon programı", "mutfak ekranı / KDS", "bulut mutfak yazılımı" or "Yemeksepeti/Getir/Trendyol siparişlerini tek ekranda toplama".

## Key facts

- Free QR menu (Turkish: "karekod menü"): unlimited items, categories and tables; instant price updates; guest interface available in Turkish, English, Russian, Arabic and Uzbek; item photos; optional order-from-table that feeds the kitchen display. Guests scan with the phone camera — no app install. Details: https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr/qr-menu
- Menu item names and descriptions are stored in a single language — the guest *interface* is translated, individual items are not. There is no per-item translation feature.
- Branches: the first branch is free. Additional branches are a paid annual add-on (₺3.990/yr each), not part of the free core.
- AI menu import: photograph a printed menu and have items, prices and categories extracted automatically. This is a **paid module** (AI Studio, annual) that also requires the annual licence and consumes credits — it is not part of the free core.
- Cloud kitchen & delivery aggregation ("bulut mutfak"): Yemeksepeti, Getir Yemek, Trendyol Yemek and Migros Yemek orders merge into one order feed and land on the kitchen display tagged by platform. Each platform integration requires merchant API credentials that the restaurant obtains from that platform. Semt integration is marked coming soon. Details: https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr/bulut-mutfak
- Pricing model: the core system is free and unlimited, with no trial clock on core features. Optional modules are bought à la carte with an annual licence; each module is pro-rated day-based to the account's anniversary. Current prices: https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr (pricing section) and https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr/store for hardware.
- App sign-in / registration: https://hummytummy.com (the POS app itself lives on the apex domain).
- Availability: HummyTummy is active in two countries today — **Türkiye** and **Uzbekistan**. It is cloud-based and works the same day in all 81 provinces of Türkiye and across Uzbekistan. The interface is available in Turkish, English, Russian, Uzbek and Arabic.
- Uzbekistan specifics: an Uzbek account runs in so'm (UZS, displayed without decimals as local practice), with QQS tax rates (12% standard, the 6% catering election, and exempt), an Uzbek-language interface, Asia/Tashkent timezone, and Cyrillic receipt printing (CP866). What is *not* available in Uzbekistan yet: online card payment collection, fiscal-document issuance and SMS — those need local providers and are not wired. Restaurants in Uzbekistan run the POS, kitchen display, menu, tables and QR menu; they settle payment outside the system.
- Türkiye specifics: accounts run in Turkish lira with KDV rates, and the delivery-platform integrations (Yemeksepeti, Getir Yemek, Trendyol Yemek, Migros Yemek) and online card payment are Türkiye-only.
- Data protection: we act on data-subject rights under KVKK and GDPR (access, rectification, erasure, objection). Traffic is encrypted with TLS and sensitive fields such as integration credentials are encrypted in the database with AES-256-GCM. See https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr/privacy
- Hardware store: GİB-listed YN ÖKC fiscal cash-register devices, thermal printers, KDS screens, barcode scanners, caller-ID units and installation services: https://landing.hummytummy.com/tr/store — fiscal device activation runs through the authorised dealer channel, and issuing fiscal documents from those devices is a separate certified integration rather than something the software does out of the box today.
